_comment: EDIT THIS FILE after each RBA meeting. rebuild.py reads it and regenerates index.html. Everything here is editorial judgement or data with no free API - it cannot be fetched automatically. The 'editorial_as_of' date below is printed on the dashboard and ages visibly, so stale commentary is obvious rather than silent.

setup_blurb.headline: The setup:
setup_blurb.text: Board held unanimously in August with the hike bias explicitly retained. June-quarter CPI undershot at 3.8% headline / 3.6% trimmed mean, which shifted consensus firmly to a hold. Bullock says the Board is not ruling out further rises if inflation looks like staying above target for longer than forecast.
setup_blurb.secondary: CBA expects on hold through 2026. Fuel excise roll-off is expected to lift September-quarter headline inflation.

members.name: Michele Bullock
members.view: Told the Anika Foundation the Board was prepared to act as required, warning that deferring tight policy can mean higher rates and higher unemployment later. After the August hold, said the Board is not ruling out further rises if inflation looks like staying above target for longer than forecast.
members.src: Anika Foundation speech, 28 Jul 2026 · Media conference, 11 Aug 2026

members.name: Andrew Hauser
members.view: Backed the unanimous August hold. Has consistently framed risks to inflation as skewed to the upside while acknowledging the economy is slowing broadly as anticipated.

members.name: Jenny Wilkinson PSM
members.view: Represents the fiscal authority's perspective. No independent public statements on policy direction. Voted with the unanimous August decision.

members.name: Carolyn Hewson AO
members.view: Emphasised the practical application of economic thinking and the value of business liaison over models alone. Tone consistent with the hawkish majority; no explicit rate call.

members.name: Bruce Preston
members.view: UNSW macroeconomist, former senior RBA and Treasury adviser. No public speeches yet. Voted with the majority to hike in May and with the unanimous August hold.

members.name: Renée Fry-McKibbin
members.view: ANU academic economist. Backed lower rates on the ANU shadow board in early 2022, historically a dovish signal. No speeches yet under the transparency framework.

members.name: Iain Ross AO
members.view: Former Fair Work Commission President; brings a labour market lens. No speeches yet under the transparency framework. Unemployment at 4.1% and forecast to drift higher.

members.name: Marnie Baker AM
members.view: Former Bendigo & Adelaide Bank CEO; financial sector perspective. No public statements on policy direction under the transparency framework.

members.name: Vacant (Harper seat)
members.view: Ian Harper AO's term ended with the August 2026 meeting, which Bullock confirmed was his last. Successor not reflected here — update this entry when the appointment is announced.
